**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:01:06
Absolutely. All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption. We use customer-managed keys through AWS KMS, so you maintain control of your encryption keys at all times.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:01:22

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:01:24
TLS 1.3 for all data in transit. We don't support older TLS versions.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:01:31
Good. What about data residency? We have requirements to keep data within the US.

**DIANA FOSTER** | 00:01:38
We can absolutely accommodate that. We have regions in US East and US West. You can configure your tenant to be single-region US only, and we contractually guarantee that data won't leave those regions.

**SARAH CHEN** | 00:01:54
What about backups? Are those also kept in the US?

**DIANA FOSTER** | 00:01:58
Yes. Backups are stored in the same region as your primary data. We use S3 with cross-AZ replication but not cross-region unless you opt into our disaster recovery package.

**JENNIFER WALSH** | 00:02:13
Speaking of disaster recovery, what's your RTO and RPO?

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:02:18
Standard tier is 4-hour RTO and 1-hour RPO. Our premium tier offers 1-hour RTO and 15-minute RPO. That includes cross-region failover.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:02:32
Let's talk about access controls. How do you manage access to customer data internally?

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:02:40
We follow the principle of least privilege. Our engineering team has no standing access to production customer data. Access requires approval through our privileged access management system, is logged, and automatically expires after 4 hours.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:02:58
How often is that access reviewed?

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:03:01
Weekly for any access granted. We also do quarterly reviews of access policies and permissions.

**SARAH CHEN** | 00:03:10

**DIANA FOSTER** | 00:03:13
We're SOC 2 Type II certified. Our most recent audit was completed in December. I can share the report after this call if you sign an NDA.

**SARAH CHEN** | 00:03:25
Yes, we'd like to review that.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:03:28
What about penetration testing?

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:03:31
We do annual third-party penetration tests. We also have a bug bounty program that runs year-round. Our last pentest was in October, and I can share the executive summary.

**DAVID KIM** | 00:03:46
Were there any critical or high findings?

**MARCUS WEBB** | 00:03:49
No critical findings. There were two high findings related to session management that were remediated within 48 hours of disclosure.

**JENNIFER WALSH** | 00:04:02

**DIANA FOSTER** | 00:04:14
We have a full REST API for all platform functionality. We also have native integrations with most major SIEMs including Splunk. For your custom tooling, our API is well-documented and we provide SDKs for Python, Java, and Go.

**JENNIFER WALSH** | 00:04:32
What about webhook support for real-time alerting?

**DIANA FOSTER** | 00:04:36
Yes, we support webhooks for all alert types. You can also integrate with PagerDuty, Slack, and Teams natively.

We offer 99.9% uptime SLA on our standard tier, and 99.99% on premium. Credits are automatic if we miss SLA - you don't have to file a claim.
